---
title: "Connect your coding agent"
sidebarTitle: "Overview"
description: "Connect the coding agent you use and talk to it from your phone."
keywords: ["Relay", "coding agents", "connect"]
---

Run one command for the agent you use:

```bash
npx relaymessenger@staging connect claude-code
```
